paragraphs.text: The Alara block is the fifteenth block consisting of the large expansion Shards of Alara ( ) and two small expansions , Conflux ( ) and Alara Reborn ( ). The block came out in 2008–2009.
Keywords introduced in this block: devour , exalted , unearth , cascade .
Keywords/ ability words reused from the past: cycling , domain (now an ability word with Conflux ), typecycling (expanded upon with basic land cycling).
This block introduces the mythic rare rarity.
A special Alara block all- foil booster pack, containing a selection of cards from all three sets (539 total), was released on January 8, 2010 for US$11.99
